scenario: LCAP.2.9 / LDIA.3.4.2 — negative: the program sets `float: false` and writes `:: Float` on an Int slot. Rejected with DS_VALIDATE_CAPABILITY_DISABLED. Drives dsc.dialect's own_sites (a cast to `Float`).
rules_ds:
use default:
    float: false

schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule r:
    Trig t where t.v::Float > t.v::Float
->
    log info "x"
